generic.Defined scope/population: All CRM leads rejected or unqualifiable in the run window, excluding leads still sitting in the data-quality hold queue
generic.In-scope period: Leads dispositioned between the last archive run and the current cut-off in the CRM reporting time zone
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead Status, Disposition Reason, disqualification date and disqualifying user populated on every archived lead
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of leads archived in CRM equals the count landing in the warehouse lead-disposition table
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive run extract saved with run timestamp and the disposition picklist version applied
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Leads that fail to archive or carry a blank reason are logged and reworked in the next archive run
generic.Test population: All CRM leads in Disqualified or Archived status for the run period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of archived leads carry an approved Disposition Reason and none appear in active queues
generic.Exception handling path: Blank or free-text reasons are returned to the Sales Operations Analyst for recoding before sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive is accepted when every rejected lead is archived not deleted and coded from the approved list
generic.Evidence location: CRM archive run report and the warehouse lead-disposition table extract for the run date

steps.title: Extract the rejected and unqualifiable lead candidate list from CRM
sop: Run the CRM report of leads flagged rejected, unworkable or unqualifiable since the last archive run
Exclude leads still open in the data-quality hold queue so they are not archived prematurely
Done when the candidate list is produced with lead ID, owner and rejection trigger for each row
verify: Recount the candidate list against the CRM rejected-lead report for the same window
Pass when both counts agree and no data-hold lead appears on the candidate list

steps.title: Confirm the approved Disposition Reason picklist in CRM is current
sop: Open the Disposition Reason picklist on the CRM lead object and compare it to the published reason list
Confirm retired values are inactive so they cannot be selected on new dispositions
Done when the active picklist matches the published approved reason list exactly
verify: Compare the active picklist values to the published list value by value
Pass when every active value is on the published list and no retired value is selectable

steps.title: Set Lead Status to Disqualified or Archived on each candidate in CRM
sop: Apply the Disqualified or Archived status to the candidate leads using the CRM bulk update, never delete
Select the Disposition Reason from the approved picklist for each lead, no free text
Done when every candidate lead holds an archive status and a picklist disposition reason
verify: Query CRM for archived leads in the run with a blank or free-text Disposition Reason
Pass when the query returns zero rows and no candidate lead was hard deleted

steps.title: Stamp disqualification date and disqualifying user on the CRM lead
sop: Confirm the CRM update writes the disqualification date and the acting user to the lead record
Correct any record where the stamp did not write because of a validation or automation failure
Done when every archived lead shows a disqualification date and a named disqualifying user
verify: Sample archived leads across the run and inspect the stamped date and user fields
Pass when all sampled leads carry both stamps and the date falls inside the run window

steps.title: Remove archived leads from active routing and nurture queues in CRM
sop: Check the active routing queue and nurture membership lists for any lead now in archive status
Remove archived leads from routing queues and suppress them from nurture flows in the CRM
Done when no archived lead holds membership in an active routing or nurture queue
verify: Cross-join the archived lead list against active routing and nurture membership in CRM
Pass when the intersection is empty for the run period

steps.title: Confirm archived leads land in the warehouse lead-disposition table
sop: Wait for the next warehouse load and query the lead-disposition table for the run date
Compare the loaded row count and reason mix against the CRM archive run report
Done when the warehouse table carries every archived lead with its disposition reason
verify: Reconcile CRM archived count to warehouse lead-disposition row count for the run date
Pass when the two counts agree or every difference has a logged load-timing cause

steps.title: Log archive exceptions and rework items in the CRM exception queue
sop: Record leads that failed to archive, lost their stamp or missed the warehouse load as exceptions
Assign each exception an owner and a rework due date inside the next run cycle
Done when every archive exception carries an owner, cause and due date
verify: Review the exception queue for items without an owner or a due date
Pass when every open archive exception has both and none is past due unescalated

generic.Defined scope/population: All inbound leads from web forms, the self-service portal, broker portal, call centre and campaign landing pages
generic.In-scope period: Leads created in CRM during the capture reporting day, measured in the CRM reporting time zone
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lead Source, Lead Source Detail, UTM campaign, medium and content populated on every created lead
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Form submission counts per channel reconcile to CRM lead creations for the same window
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Created Date and time plus originating channel retained so first-touch attribution is reconstructable
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed form-to-CRM syncs are logged with channel, payload reference and replay outcome
generic.Test population: All CRM leads created in the last 24 hours across every inbound channel
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every new lead carries a Lead Source and a linked Campaign Member record with zero open sync failures
generic.Exception handling path: Sync failures are replayed from the marketing automation platform queue and re-checked in CRM
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Capture is accepted when each channel lead reaches CRM once with full source and campaign attribution
generic.Evidence location: CRM lead creation report, marketing automation sync log and the campaign member extract

steps.title: Confirm channel-to-CRM capture integrations are running in the marketing automation platform
sop: Check the connector status for web forms, landing pages, the self-service portal and the broker feed
Confirm the last successful sync timestamp for each channel is inside the expected interval
Done when every inbound channel connector reports healthy with a recent successful sync
verify: Review the connector status page and last-sync timestamps for all active channels
Pass when no channel connector is disabled or stale beyond its expected interval

steps.title: Map incoming payload fields to CRM lead source and attribution fields
sop: Confirm Lead Source and Lead Source Detail map from the approved taxonomy values in the payload
Confirm hidden UTM campaign, medium and content fields map to the CRM attribution fields
Done when every capture channel has a complete field map with no orphan mappings
verify: Submit a test payload per channel and inspect the resulting CRM lead field values
Pass when all mapped source and UTM fields land populated on the test lead

steps.title: Create the CRM lead record for each inbound submission
sop: Allow the integration to create the lead and confirm the record appears with the submitted contact data
Confirm Created Date, time and originating channel are written at creation
Done when each in-scope submission has exactly one CRM lead record
verify: Compare submission counts per channel to CRM lead creations for the same window
Pass when counts agree channel by channel within the agreed tolerance

steps.title: Create the Campaign Member link between the lead and its originating campaign
sop: Confirm the campaign referenced in the payload exists and is active in CRM
Create the Campaign Member record linking the new lead to that campaign
Done when every campaign-sourced lead has a Campaign Member row
verify: Query campaign-sourced leads created today without a Campaign Member record
Pass when the query returns no rows

steps.title: Stamp the referring producer or agency code on broker portal leads
sop: Read the producer or agency code from the broker and agent portal payload
Write the code to the referring producer field on the CRM lead and validate it against the producer list
Done when every portal-sourced lead names a valid referring producer or agency
verify: List portal-sourced leads with a blank or unmatched referring producer code
Pass when the list is empty for the capture day

steps.title: Reconcile captured leads to channel submission counts
sop: Pull submission counts per channel and per campaign for the same window and time zone as CRM
Compare against CRM lead creations and calculate the variance per channel
Done when every channel variance is either zero or traced to a named cause
verify: Review the per-channel variance table for the capture day
Pass when no variance above tolerance is left without a documented cause

steps.title: Replay and clear failed form-to-CRM sync errors
sop: Open the marketing automation sync error queue and inspect each failed submission payload
Correct the mapping or data fault and replay the payload into CRM
Done when the sync error queue holds no unresolved capture failures for the day
verify: Re-check the error queue and confirm replayed payloads produced CRM leads
Pass when every failure is either resolved into a lead or logged with a disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: Every published lead capture form across web, campaign landing pages and the customer self-service portal
generic.In-scope period: Form versions live during the current configuration release window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Name, contact, ZIP or state and product interest marked required at the form layer on every variant
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of published form fields equals the count of mapped CRM lead fields with no orphans
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Form definition export saved per variant with version number and publish timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped fields or failed test submissions are logged and fixed before the form stays live
generic.Test population: All published lead capture form variants in the release
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every form maps all fields to CRM, carries hidden UTM fields and shows an unchecked consent box
generic.Exception handling path: A form failing the test submission is unpublished until the mapping or consent defect is corrected
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Configuration is accepted when a live test submission creates one CRM lead with all mapped values
generic.Evidence location: Marketing automation form configuration export and the CRM test lead record

steps.title: List every published lead capture form across the platform and portal
sop: Export the active form inventory from the marketing automation platform and the self-service portal
Include campaign landing page variants so no variant is reviewed by assumption
Done when a complete inventory of live form variants exists with owner and URL
verify: Spot-check live campaign pages against the inventory list
Pass when every live form found on a page appears in the inventory

steps.title: Set required fields at the form layer for each variant
sop: Mark name, contact, ZIP or state and product interest as required in the form builder
Confirm client-side validation blocks submission when a required field is blank
Done when every variant enforces the required field set at the form layer
verify: Attempt a submission with each required field blank on a sample of variants
Pass when the form blocks the submission and names the missing field

steps.title: Map each form field to its matching CRM lead field
sop: Open the field mapping for each form and pair every input to a CRM lead field
Remove or repoint mappings that target retired or deleted CRM fields
Done when every form field has a live CRM target and no orphan mapping remains
verify: Compare the form field list to the mapping table for each variant
Pass when the counts match and no mapping points to an inactive CRM field

steps.title: Render the consent checkbox unchecked with adjacent disclosure text
sop: Confirm the marketing consent checkbox default state is unchecked on every variant
Confirm the disclosure text sits adjacent to the checkbox and names the channels covered
Done when no variant ships a pre-checked consent box and all show the disclosure
verify: Load each live form and inspect the rendered consent control and disclosure placement
Pass when every form renders the box unchecked with the disclosure visible beside it

steps.title: Add hidden UTM and source fields to every form variant
sop: Insert hidden fields for UTM campaign, medium, content and originating source on each variant
Confirm the hidden values populate from the page query string at render time
Done when every variant carries the hidden attribution field set
verify: Load a form with UTM parameters in the URL and inspect the hidden field values
Pass when all hidden attribution fields capture the query string values

steps.title: Run a live test submission and inspect the created CRM lead
sop: Submit the live form with a seed record containing distinct values in every field
Open the created CRM lead and compare each field against the submitted values
Done when the test submission creates exactly one CRM lead with all mapped values populated
verify: Compare the seed payload to the CRM lead field by field
Pass when every mapped value matches and only one lead was created

steps.title: Publish the form version and record the configuration evidence
sop: Publish the corrected form variants and record the version number and publish timestamp
Export the form definition and mapping table into the marketing operations evidence store
Done when every live variant has a stored definition export tied to its version
verify: Check the evidence store holds a current export for each live variant
Pass when no live variant is missing a versioned configuration export

generic.Defined scope/population: All newly captured CRM leads awaiting assignment, matched against existing leads, contacts and accounts
generic.In-scope period: Leads created since the last deduplication pass through the current run cut-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Email, phone and name with ZIP present so the match keys can be evaluated on every candidate
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: New leads in equals surviving leads plus merged leads plus dropped duplicates for the run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Merge log retained with run timestamp, match rule version and surviving record ID per merge
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ambiguous matches are logged for manual review with the reviewer decision recorded
generic.Test population: All open CRM leads after the deduplication run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No two open leads share an email address or a phone number after the run
generic.Exception handling path: Low-confidence matches are held for manual adjudication rather than merged automatically
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run is accepted when duplicates are resolved and survivors keep the earliest Created Date and source
generic.Evidence location: CRM duplicate rule run log and the warehouse merge history extract

steps.title: Assemble the new lead candidate set in CRM for the dedup run
sop: Select CRM leads created since the last deduplication pass and not yet assigned
Confirm each candidate has at least one usable match key of email, phone or name with ZIP
Done when the candidate set is fixed with a run identifier and record count
verify: Recount the candidate set against the CRM new-lead report for the window
Pass when the counts agree and no candidate lacks every match key

steps.title: Run the CRM duplicate rules on email, phone and name plus ZIP
sop: Execute the duplicate rule set across the candidates using all three match keys
Record the match confidence returned for each candidate pair
Done when every candidate carries a match result and confidence value
verify: Check that the rule version used matches the approved duplicate rule set
Pass when all three match keys ran and every candidate has a recorded result

steps.title: Check candidates against existing customer and account records in CRM
sop: Match candidates to existing contacts and accounts, not only to other leads
Flag matches to a known policyholder so they are not created as net-new leads
Done when every candidate is tested against the customer and account population
verify: Sample candidates with known policyholder emails and inspect the match outcome
Pass when each known policyholder candidate is flagged rather than left as net new

steps.title: Select the surviving record and carry forward earliest date and source
sop: Choose the survivor for each duplicate set using the approved survivorship rule
Write the earliest Created Date and the original Lead Source onto the surviving record
Done when every survivor holds the earliest Created Date and the original Lead Source
verify: Compare survivor Created Date and Lead Source against the duplicate set members
Pass when no survivor holds a later date or a replacement source value

steps.title: Merge consent and do-not-call flags to the most restrictive value
sop: Compare per-channel consent flags and do-not-call status across each duplicate set
Write the most restrictive value of each flag onto the surviving record
Done when the survivor carries the most restrictive consent and do-not-call position
verify: Sample merged sets where members disagreed on a consent flag
Pass when the survivor always holds the restrictive value from the set

steps.title: Mark the duplicate lead as Merged with a pointer to the survivor
sop: Set the non-surviving lead status to Merged rather than deleting the record
Write the surviving record ID onto the merged lead for traceability
Done when every merged lead holds a survivor pointer and a Merged status
verify: Query merged leads with a blank surviving record ID
Pass when the query returns no rows for the run

steps.title: Adjudicate low-confidence matches and log the outcome
sop: Review the held low-confidence pairs individually rather than force-merging them
Record merge or keep-separate decisions with the reason on each pair
Done when the ambiguous queue is cleared with a decision on every pair
verify: Check the ambiguous queue for pairs left undecided past the run
Pass when every held pair carries a recorded decision and reason

generic.Defined scope/population: Lead source values for digital, producer and agency, referral, aggregator, event and inbound call channels
generic.In-scope period: Taxonomy version effective from the published effective date until the next approved revision
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each source entry carries a Lead Source, a Lead Source Detail and an allowed pairing rule
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of published taxonomy values equals the count of active CRM picklist values
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published taxonomy stored in the marketing operations repository with version number and effective date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requested source values outside the taxonomy are logged and either approved into it or rejected
generic.Test population: All active CRM lead source picklist values and all leads created after the effective date
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: CRM picklist matches the published taxonomy exactly and no lead uses an off-taxonomy value
generic.Exception handling path: Off-taxonomy values found in CRM are remapped to the approved replacement and the source fixed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Taxonomy is accepted when every channel family is covered and retired values map to replacements
generic.Evidence location: Marketing operations repository taxonomy document and the CRM picklist configuration export

steps.title: Inventory current lead source values in CRM and the warehouse
sop: Export active and inactive Lead Source values from CRM with usage counts by period
Pull historic source values from the warehouse so retired values in reporting are visible
Done when a single inventory lists every source value in use with its volume
verify: Compare the inventory against CRM picklist configuration and warehouse distinct values
Pass when no source value present in either system is missing from the inventory

steps.title: Define the source value set for each channel family
sop: Agree values for digital, producer and agency, referral, aggregator, event and inbound call
Keep the value set small enough to be selected reliably at capture time
Done when every channel family has an agreed set of source values
verify: Check each named channel family against the drafted value set
Pass when no channel family is left without at least one source value

steps.title: Agree the two-level Lead Source and Lead Source Detail structure
sop: Define which Detail values are allowed under each Source value
Document the allowed pairings so invalid combinations can be blocked in CRM
Done when the allowed pairing matrix is complete for every Source value
verify: Test sample pairings against the matrix including deliberately invalid ones
Pass when every valid pairing is listed and invalid pairings are excluded

steps.title: Publish the UTM naming convention alongside the source list
sop: Define the naming pattern for UTM campaign, medium and content values
Show worked examples so campaign builders apply the pattern consistently
Done when the UTM convention is written and paired with the source list
verify: Apply the convention to a sample of live campaigns and check for conflicts
Pass when every sampled campaign name can be expressed under the convention

steps.title: Map legacy and retired source values to their replacements
sop: List every retired or legacy value from the inventory and name its replacement
Confirm the mapping keeps historic reporting totals tied out in the warehouse
Done when every retired value has a documented replacement mapping
verify: Rerun a historic period report through the mapping and compare to the original totals
Pass when mapped totals tie to the original totals for the test period

steps.title: Align CRM picklist values to the published taxonomy
sop: Add approved values, deactivate retired values and enforce the allowed pairings in CRM
Avoid deleting values still referenced by historic records
Done when active CRM picklists mirror the published taxonomy
verify: Export the CRM picklist configuration and compare value by value to the taxonomy
Pass when the two lists match exactly including inactive retired values

steps.title: Publish the taxonomy with effective date and version number
sop: Store the approved taxonomy in the marketing operations repository with version and effective date
Notify capture channel owners of the effective date and the values they must adopt
Done when the versioned taxonomy is published and the effective date communicated
verify: Check the repository entry for version, effective date and approver
Pass when all three are present and the version matches the CRM configuration

generic.Defined scope/population: CRM leads eligible for append, excluding any lead flagged as opted out of data sharing
generic.In-scope period: Leads captured or refreshed within the current enrichment batch window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provider name, append timestamp and match confidence populated on every enriched attribute
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Leads submitted to the provider equals leads returned plus leads left unenriched by low confidence
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Enrichment batch file retained with provider name, run timestamp and permissible purpose reference
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Low-confidence and failed appends are logged and left unenriched rather than force-matched
generic.Test population: All CRM leads processed in the enrichment batch
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every appended attribute carries provider, timestamp and confidence with zero opted-out leads sent
generic.Exception handling path: Appends below the confidence floor are discarded and the lead routed for manual research
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Enrichment is accepted when appended data sits in dedicated fields and prospect values are untouched
generic.Evidence location: Enrichment batch log in the warehouse and the CRM lead enrichment field audit history

steps.title: Confirm and record permissible purpose before any consumer-report append
sop: Confirm the permissible purpose for the intended use of consumer-report-derived attributes
Record the purpose reference against the enrichment batch definition
Done when the batch carries a recorded permissible purpose before any data is requested
verify: Inspect the batch definition for a recorded permissible purpose reference
Pass when the reference is present and dated before the provider call

steps.title: Build the enrichment input set and suppress opted-out leads
sop: Select eligible CRM leads for the batch window using the enrichment eligibility rule
Exclude every lead flagged as opted out of data sharing from the input file
Done when the input set excludes all opted-out leads and is counted
verify: Join the input set against the opted-out flag population in CRM
Pass when the intersection is empty for the batch

steps.title: Submit the batch to the credit bureau and data services provider
sop: Transmit the input file through the agreed secure channel to the data services provider
Record the submission timestamp and the record count sent
Done when the provider acknowledges receipt of the full record count
verify: Compare the provider acknowledgement count to the submitted count
Pass when the two counts agree for the batch

steps.title: Write appended attributes to dedicated CRM enrichment fields
sop: Load returned attributes into the dedicated enrichment fields on the CRM lead
Never overwrite the prospect-supplied contact or product interest values
Done when every returned attribute sits in an enrichment field with the source value intact
verify: Compare prospect-supplied fields before and after the load on a sample of leads
Pass when no prospect-supplied value changed during the enrichment load

steps.title: Store match confidence and hold low-confidence records unenriched
sop: Write the provider match confidence score onto each enriched lead
Discard appends below the agreed confidence floor and leave those leads unenriched
Done when every enriched lead carries a confidence score above the floor
verify: List enriched leads with a confidence below the floor or a blank score
Pass when that list is empty for the batch

steps.title: Stamp provider name and append timestamp on each enriched lead
sop: Write the provider name and the append timestamp onto the enriched lead record
Confirm the stamps survive downstream CRM automation and do not get cleared
Done when every enriched lead names its provider and append time
verify: Query enriched leads with a missing provider name or append timestamp
Pass when the query returns no rows

steps.title: Log enrichment exceptions and reconcile the batch in the warehouse
sop: Record no-match, low-confidence and error rows as batch exceptions with a disposition
Reconcile submitted, returned and enriched counts in the warehouse batch log
Done when the batch reconciles and every exception carries a disposition
verify: Compare submitted count to returned plus unenriched plus error counts in the log
Pass when the reconciliation balances and no exception lacks a disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: Every active lead capture channel and campaign reporting lead volumes for the reconciliation period
generic.In-scope period: The reconciliation window using the same date range and time zone on both sides of the comparison
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Channel-reported count, CRM count, variance and variance percentage present for each channel row
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Channel-reported lead counts agree with CRM lead counts per channel and per campaign within tolerance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation extract retained with pull timestamp and the warehouse table version used
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances above tolerance are logged as data issues against the owning integration
generic.Test population: All active capture channels and campaigns for the reconciliation period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every channel variance sits inside the agreed tolerance or carries a traced cause
generic.Exception handling path: Untraced gaps are raised as a data issue ticket to the integration owner before sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciliation is accepted when per-channel and per-campaign variance is explained or inside tolerance
generic.Evidence location: Warehouse reconciliation table and the BI reconciliation report for the period

steps.title: Pull channel-reported lead counts into the warehouse for the window
sop: Extract lead counts from each channel platform for the reconciliation window
Convert every source to the CRM reporting time zone before loading
Done when channel counts for all active channels are loaded for the window
verify: Check each active channel has a loaded count row for the window
Pass when no active channel is missing from the loaded set

steps.title: Pull matching CRM lead creation counts for the same window
sop: Query CRM lead creations by Lead Source and campaign for the identical date range
Apply the same time zone and cut-off used for the channel extract
Done when CRM counts are produced at channel and campaign grain
verify: Compare the CRM query date bounds to the channel extract bounds
Pass when both use the same range, cut-off and time zone

steps.title: Compare counts per channel and per campaign in the BI report
sop: Join channel and CRM counts at both channel and campaign grain in the BI platform
Avoid netting differences at the total level where offsetting gaps can hide
Done when a per-channel and per-campaign comparison table is produced
verify: Check the report shows campaign-grain rows and not only channel totals
Pass when both grains are present for every active channel

steps.title: Calculate variance percentage against the agreed tolerance
sop: Compute absolute and percentage variance for every comparison row
Flag rows breaching the agreed tolerance threshold for investigation
Done when each row shows a variance percentage and a tolerance flag
verify: Recompute variance on a sample of rows independently
Pass when the recomputed values match the report and flags fire at the threshold

steps.title: Trace each flagged variance to a cause
sop: Test each flagged row against duplicate suppression, sync failure, bot filtering and timing lag
Record the identified cause and the supporting evidence on the row
Done when every flagged variance carries a named cause
verify: Review flagged rows for a recorded cause and evidence reference
Pass when no flagged row is left without both

steps.title: Raise a data issue ticket for unexplained gaps
sop: Log a data issue against the owning integration for every gap that resists tracing
Include channel, period, variance size and the investigation already done
Done when every unexplained gap has an open ticket with a named owner
verify: Match unexplained rows to open data issue tickets
Pass when each unexplained row references an open ticket

steps.title: Publish the reconciliation report and retain the evidence
sop: Publish the report showing channel count, CRM count and variance percentage per channel
Retain the extract with pull timestamp in the warehouse reconciliation table
Done when the report is published and the evidence extract retained
verify: Open the published report and confirm all three columns and the as-of timestamp
Pass when the report is complete and the retained extract matches it

generic.Defined scope/population: All leads captured through any channel that will receive email, text or autodialed telephone contact
generic.In-scope period: Consent events recorded from lead creation through to any later revocation in the period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-channel consent flags, consent timestamp, source form ID, IP address and disclosure version populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Consent records in the marketing automation platform reconcile to consent flags on the CRM lead
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disclosure text version shown to the prospect retained with the consent timestamp as proof of consent
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Consent capture failures and late revocations are logged with the remediation action taken
generic.Test population: All leads with a recorded consent or revocation event in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every lead carries per-channel flags with timestamp, form ID and disclosure version and zero unconsented contacts
generic.Exception handling path: Leads with incomplete consent proof are suppressed from outbound channels until proof is restored
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consent is accepted when proof elements are complete and revocations apply inside the required window
generic.Evidence location: CRM consent fields, marketing automation consent log and the retained disclosure text versions

steps.title: Configure per-channel consent flags on the CRM lead record
sop: Create or confirm separate flags for email, SMS text and autodialed or prerecorded call consent
Prevent a single blanket consent flag from standing in for all three channels
Done when the CRM lead holds three independent per-channel consent flags
verify: Inspect the CRM lead object field set for the three consent flags
Pass when all three exist independently and none is derived from another

steps.title: Capture the exact disclosure text version shown to the prospect
sop: Version the disclosure text used on each form and pass the version with the submission
Write the disclosure version to the CRM lead alongside the consent flag
Done when every consent record names the disclosure version shown
verify: Sample consent records and match the version to the archived disclosure text
Pass when each sampled version resolves to a retained disclosure text

steps.title: Record consent timestamp, source form ID and IP address as proof
sop: Pass the submission timestamp, source URL or form ID and IP address with the consent event
Write all three onto the CRM lead as the proof-of-consent set
Done when every consent event carries timestamp, form ID and IP address
verify: Query consent records missing any of the three proof elements
Pass when the query returns no rows for the period

steps.title: Screen lead phone numbers against the internal do-not-call list
sop: Run captured phone numbers against the internal do-not-call list on creation
Write the do-not-call flag to the CRM lead where a match is found
Done when every lead with a phone number carries a screened do-not-call flag
verify: List leads with a phone number and no do-not-call screening result
Pass when that list is empty for the period

steps.title: Record revocation events and update the channel flags
sop: Log every unsubscribe, stop reply or revocation request with the date received
Clear the affected channel consent flag inside the required response window
Done when each revocation is reflected in the channel flags within the window
verify: Measure elapsed time from revocation received to flag update on a sample
Pass when every sampled revocation was applied inside the required window

steps.title: Suppress unconsented leads from outbound text and dialer lists
sop: Apply the consent flags as the gate on outbound text and autodialed call list builds
Exclude any lead without recorded prior express written consent from those lists
Done when outbound lists are built only from leads holding the matching consent
verify: Join the latest outbound text and dialer lists against the consent flags
Pass when no listed lead lacks the required consent flag

steps.title: Reconcile consent records between CRM and the automation platform
sop: Compare per-channel consent state between the CRM lead and the marketing automation record
Correct the mismatched side to the most restrictive position and log the exception
Done when consent state agrees across both systems for every lead in scope
verify: Run the consent mismatch query across both systems
Pass when the mismatch list is empty or every remaining item is logged with a disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: CRM leads that failed a validation check before scoring, across all capture channels
generic.In-scope period: Validation failures raised in the current remediation cycle up to the SLA cut-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Failure reason code, remediation due date and hold status populated on every held lead
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Leads placed on hold equals leads released plus leads disqualified plus leads still inside SLA
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hold and release events retained with timestamps and the validation rule version applied
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Leads still failing after SLA are disqualified with a data-quality disposition, never left open
generic.Test population: All CRM leads in Data Hold status during the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No held lead reaches the scoring queue and every held lead carries a reason code and due date
generic.Exception handling path: Leads that cannot be remediated from enrichment or source payload go to prospect contact or disqualification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Remediation is accepted when each held lead is released, disqualified or inside its SLA window
generic.Evidence location: CRM data hold queue report and the warehouse validation failure log

steps.title: Apply the Data Hold status to leads failing validation in CRM
